newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index fell 2.38 pct in September.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index fell 2.38 pct in September.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index dropped by 2.38 percent in September compared to its average in August, bourse statistics published on Thursday showed.
The average index for September was 612.39 with the highest at 618.25 and the lowest at 602.67. In August, the average was 615.66 with the highest at 623.69 and the lowest at 611.88.
During September, the index followed a downward trend almost each day.
Total volume traded was 86 million dinars in September against 70 million dinars in August. On the first market, the volume was 22 million dinars in September, down from 31 million dinars in August.
Among the biggest winners in September, were BTEI bank which average price for a share was up 15.05 percent at 22.69 dinars, and Arab Tunisian Bank which won 12.08 percent at 56.84 dinars.
Investment fund SPDIT-SICAF average price in September was down 12.53 percent to 42.17 dinars and coke bottler SFBT lost 8.89 percent to 138.08 dinars. ($=0.97 dinar)
